class.name: MVSurface
class.brief_description: Grip and rolling resistance of one driving surface.
class.description: Describes how tires behave on one kind of ground. A wheel resolves the surface it is touching from the node groups of the collider: the first group whose name equals [member name] selects this surface. Surfaces are collected in an [MVSurfaceLibrary]. Every setter clamps the value to its valid range and emits [signal Resource.changed] only when the value actually changed; wheels pick the change up on their next physics tick.

members.member: Multiplier for the amount of force a tire can apply on this surface.
Extra lateral grip proportional to the lateral slip. Keeps vehicles from sliding long distances, at the cost of unrealistically high grip.
Scales longitudinal grip relative to lateral grip. Lower values let the wheels spin while the vehicle keeps its lateral grip.
Node group name that selects this surface. Add your static and rigid bodies to a group with this name.
Multiplier for the rolling resistance force on this surface.
Tire stiffness in the brush tire model. Higher values make the tire respond faster to slip. Internally scaled to [code]1e6 + 8e6 * tire_stiffness[/code] N/m.
